text:
TMM::cmp_count
Description
This command provides the active number of TMM instances running.
To determine the blade the iRule is currently executing on, see the
TMM::cmp_group
page. To determine the CPU ID
an iRule is currently executing on within a blade, see the
TMM::cmp_unit
page.
Syntax
TMM
::
cmp_count
Examples
when
CLIENT_ACCEPTED
{
if
{
[
TMM
::
cmp_count
]
>=
2
}
{
set
cmpstatus
1
}
else
{
set
cmpstatus
0
}
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
ALL_EVENTS
,
GLOBAL_GTM
